_doc: Your details for application forms. Copy to config/profile.json (git-ignored) and fill it in. Only put TRUE facts here: the form fillers type these answers into real applications.

work_auth._doc: Set these to YOUR situation. sponsorship_now: do you need an employer to sponsor you to start this job? sponsorship_future: will you need sponsorship later (for example OPT or STEM OPT ending, H-4 EAD, a green card)? 'Authorized to work WITHOUT sponsorship' is answered No if either is true. Older profiles with needs_sponsorship still work (read as both).

eeo._doc: Voluntary self-ID. Each value is a regex matched against the form's option text. These defaults decline to answer; replace any of them with your own answer if you want to share it.

work_history.title: Software Engineer
work_history.description: Two or three plain sentences about what you built, with real numbers.

evidence_of_excellence: One paragraph on your strongest, verifiable achievement (Tesla asks for this).

amazon_years._doc: Amazon screening dropdowns: option text to pick for each question type. Use the band that matches your real experience.

workday_experience_bands._doc: Workday 'how much experience with X' questions: label regex -> option regex. Only list areas where you know your real band.

overleaf._doc: Optional. Leave project_url empty to compile locally with pdflatex instead.

tracker._doc: URL of YOUR tracker artifact (see setup/SETUP.md step 4) and the database collection name.

job_search_email_note: email above is the address used for career-site accounts

notice_options._doc: Site-specific dropdown text for your notice period.

answers._doc: Yes/No facts the form fillers type for you (automation/lib/answers.js). All null here on purpose: onboarding asks each one, and a null answer stops the filler. Only true answers.

consents._doc: Legal steps the fillers take in your name. Onboarding asks about each one separately. false = the filler stops and asks you.

_doc_limits: daily_cap: most applications per day, or null for no daily limit (per-company limits still apply). per_run: roles per keep-applying run, or null for as many as qualify (a run still stops after about 25 minutes).
